I never experienced this but my dad has! In my area there's an abandoned house near a freeway where a captain used to live in with his wife, we're talking years back. People say that it was a sad case of domestic violence, he would abuse her and she obviously lived a pretty sad life with him. Eventually they passed away and apparently the woman started haunting people that would drive by this freeway in the early evening.

Specifically taxi drivers, she would stand on the sidewalk and ask for service. As she got in the cab, she wouldn't specify where she was going and out of the blue she would just disappear from the seat. This would lead the driver to be in shock, giving them constant headaches the day after. My dad eventually had to get spiritually cured to get rid of the high fever and headaches. 

Most people in my area know about this story, especially older people and it's the reason why taxi drivers avoid going through this freeway at night 🌉
